postmortem.root_cause: Redundant addStoredBlock request received for blk_-1014865944005847876 on 10.251.123.195:50010 size 67108864
postmortem.summary: A block report for blk_-1014865944005847876 was received multiple times from the same DataNode, 10.251.123.195:50010. The NameNode logged a warning indicating this redundant request occurred after it had already recorded the replica for that block.
recommended_actions: Monitor NameNode RPC latency around the time of block reports to identify potential queue backlogs.
Check whether the DataNode 10.251.123.195 restarted or re-registered recently before the redundant report.

RB-005#Symptom.text: Redundant addStoredBlock requests - Symptom: `Redundant addStoredBlock request received for blk_... on <dn> size <n>` means a DataNode reported a replica the NameNode already has recorded on that node.

RB-004#Symptom.text: Block reported that belongs to no file - Symptom: The NameNode logs `addStoredBlock request received for blk_... on <dn> size <n> But it does not belong to any file.` when a DataNode reports a block the NameNode has no file for.

RB-005#Likely causes.text:
Redundant addStoredBlock requests - Likely causes: - A block report overlapped with the incremental report for the same replica.
- A retried report after a slow NameNode response.
- A DataNode restart that re-sent reports.

RB-005#Checks.text:
Redundant addStoredBlock requests - Checks: 1. Check NameNode RPC latency around the report time.
2. See whether the DataNode restarted or re-registered recently.

RB-005#Escalate.text: Redundant addStoredBlock requests - Escalate: Escalate if the NameNode RPC queue is backing up.
